name: GitHub Pages action
description: GitHub Actions for GitHub Pages 🚀 Deploy static files and publish your site easily. Static-Site-Generators-friendly.

deploy_key.description: Set a SSH private key from repository secret value for pushing to the remote branch.

github_token.description: Set a generated GITHUB_TOKEN for pushing to the remote branch.

personal_token.description: Set a personal access token for pushing to the remote branch.

publish_branch.description: Set a target branch for deployment.

publish_dir.description: Set an input directory for deployment.

destination_dir.description: Set an destination subdirectory for deployment.

allow_empty_commit.description: If empty commits should be made to the publication branch

keep_files.description: If existing files in the publish branch should be not removed before deploying

force_orphan.description: Keep only the latest commit on a GitHub Pages branch

commit_message.description: Set a custom commit message with a triggered commit hash

full_commit_message.description: Set a custom full commit message without a triggered commit hash

enable_jekyll.description: Enable the GitHub Pages built-in Jekyll

disable_nojekyll.description: An alias for enable_jekyll to disable adding .nojekyll file to a publishing branch

exclude_assets.description: Set files or directories to exclude from a publish directory.
